_instructions: Program item 5 (workstream D), abstention calibration. Each prompt is one a developer might type while working in this repository, and each names the repo document (a docs/adr file) whose chunks answer it. tests/test_document_ingest_graph.py ingests this repo's own docs/ into the isolated graph, builds the document pipeline with the real shared encoder and requires the named document among the top 3 primary hits for at least 10 of the 12 prompts, at the DOCUMENT_ABSTENTION_THRESHOLD value recorded in docs/adr/ADR-document-retrieval.md. The abstention side reuses tests/fixtures/ground_truth_negatives.json.

queries.prompt: How does the daemon rebuild only the indexes that changed after the graph is edited?

Why does the test suite use its own Neo4j instance on a different bolt port?
After how many consecutive failures of the same tool is the agent refused?
Which paths may an approved plan authorize writes to besides its own project?
Which injection channels does an orchestrator master keep and how is one turned off?
